## Notes

Default day lasts 8 real minutes in sixteen 30-second segments of day, dusk, and night; split varies by season; base cycle 36 days (20 summer, 16 winter); Charlie attacks in total darkness; sanity drain 5/min at dusk, 50/min in total darkness at night, 5/min near light.
